Root cause: GET /api/v1/habits/:id was never implemented on the backend (only GET /, POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id exist), so useHabit(id) always 404'd. Decision: rather than build the missing endpoint, mirrored the desktop frontend's existing pattern (findHabitById against the already-fetched habits list) since mobile already caches the full list via useHabits() and has no deep-linking need for a cold-cache single-habit fetch. Added frontends/mobile/src/utils/habitUtils.ts (findHabitById), rewrote useHabit(id) to derive from useHabits(), removed the now-dead habitsApi.getHabit. Bonus: this also fixes EditHabitScreen, which had the same root cause but wasn't in the original report. tsc clean, 250/250 tests passing. Committed 37c0edb (plus casing-mismatch prep in 8a9ba90).
